About Me

Raihan Shaikh
Property Consultant Dubai

I am Raihan Shaikh, a senior property consultant in Dubai with Homes 4 Life Real Estate. Five years in this market has taught me one thing: the deal is easy, the decision is hard. So I work the decision first. What the service charge actually costs, what the rental cheques really look like, what resale looks like four years out.

Most of my clients start in Business Bay, Downtown or Dubai Marina and end up somewhere they did not expect: JVC, Arjan, a villa in Damac Hills. That is fine. My job is not to sell you a building. It is to make sure the one you pick still makes sense to you in 2030, not just on the day you sign.

If a deal is not right for you, I will say so. There is always another one.
